column1: # Polish grammar words. One line per word as written + part of speech:
# word <TAB> UD part of speech <TAB> senses separated by " | ".
# The file replaces Wiktionary's determiner, pronoun, preposition, conjunction,
# particle and auxiliary entries for every word listed here; nouns, verbs and
# other content words stay (je "eats", mam "I have"). See src/importer/grammar.ts.

column3: me (genitive or accusative: "nie ma mnie", I'm not here; "widzisz mnie", you see me) | to me (dative, stressed) | me (after prepositions: "o mnie", about me; "u mnie", at my place)

me (instrumental, after prepositions: "ze mną", with me; "nade mną", above me)
